title: Mixed Event — SEKAI Happy New Year! — Episode2 How to Spend New Year's Eve

meta.Episode: Episode2 — How to Spend New Year's Eve
meta.Event Outline: Celebrate the New Year with Miku and the others in SEKAI! Get ready for a special episodic story featuring all group members!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K, I tweaked that thing from earlier.
What do you think of this version?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<This is much better...
Let's go with it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yay! I'm glad I asked you for feedback.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then why don't we call it a night?
We've been working for so long...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Alright. I'm staying up a bit longer to work, so you can ping me if you need anything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Are you all busy tomorrow? Because if not, I thought we could meet up and...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Because it's cold. I don't want to leave my cozy house.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Same here...
My body just stops moving when it's cold.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<Cram school for the holidays.
I may even be late logging in here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yikes, that's pretty rough to have classes while everyone else is on vacation...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If you have nothing to do, Mizuki, why don't you just stay at home?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Didn't you say you're going to a gig or a show for New Year's Eve...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, the anime song countdown event?
Unfortunately, I couldn't get tickets...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It wasn't that popular last year but they got some famous singers lined up this year, so tickets sold out fast.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I got tickets the last two years, so I thought I was good to go but...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then just stay home like I said. Don't get desperate and try to organize something on the fly.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I know but... My parents left for the holidays to visit my sis living overseas...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So I have to cook my own dinner and stuff. It's too much of a bother, so I want to go out to eat.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why I thought it'd be nice to go out with you guys...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Are you seriously going to refuse my invite? Don't you want to go hang out together?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I'm logging off now.
See you later tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Well, I failed to get anyone. Is there really no one who can hang out with me tomorrow?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I guess everybody's already got plans.
But N25 seemed like my best bet...)
The next day - New Year's Eve

rows.Speaker: Young Girl A
rows.Line: So, did you decide what you're gonna get?

rows.Speaker: Young Girl B
rows.Line:
Oh, this cake looks sooo cute.
I'm getting this one!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Sigh... Look at all the happy people having a good time here...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Man, if only I managed to get a ticket for that show, I'd be having a good time today too...)

rows.Speaker: Young Girl A
rows.Line: Hey, so what are you doing tonight?

rows.Speaker: Young Girl B
rows.Line: I'm going to a New Year's Eve party with friends, and staying over at a friend's house.

rows.Speaker: Young Girl A
rows.Line:
Aww, that sounds nice!
You're gonna have a blast!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A New Year's Eve party, huh. I wish I was going to one...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (As much as I'd like to party with N25, Mafuyu's parents seem super strict, while Ena and Kanade don't want to go out at all...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hold on a minute. There's a solution to that...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Guys! Listen up!
I've got this amazing idea!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ugh, not another one. And can you stop shouting into your mic?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I thought you were going to be late today because of cram school, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Perfect timing! I was just about to reveal my super exciting idea!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! Let's have a New Year's Eve Countdown Party!>
